retainedReferenceOnlyRecord.reason: No unique physical footprint or centerline with exact Wikidata identity has been resolved.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Two actually inspected whole-front and upper southern/western exterior pictures,standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only.No bespoke research or redistributed reference images.

pictures.author: Albertomos
pictures.observed: Actually inspected upper southern/western oblique:marble screen with broad pale/gray-green horizontal bands,stepped raking parapet,six staged open Gothic pinnacles,large central rose/four smaller oculi,pointed blind arcade and selected carved trim.Tall northwest red-brick campanile has large open belfry and stone cornices/pediments,dark cap/small lantern/finial.A separate brick octagonal crossing loggia with green copper hip and small lantern rises behind the roofs.Ground/portal are cropped.Fine sculpture,exact tracery and inscriptions are simplified.

pictures.author: Giorgio Pallavicini
pictures.observed: Actually inspected whole western front and full tall campanile at north/left.Front has five stepped bays,large central spoke rose,four smaller circular lights,pointed paired/tall windows,deep central portal and six pointed/open Gothic pinnacles.Strong white/gray-green bands carry facade identity.Clock on broad pale west tower field,red-brick shaft,large belfry apertures,four-sided pediment crown,dark cap and small top lantern/finial.Front square has a freestanding column omitted from the church model;nearby blocks remain host content.Hidden roofs/rear are not established by this view.
